'''Coachelle Prime''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] situated in the [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar sector]]. It was situated on the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] between the [[Terr'skiar system/Legends|Terr'skiar]] and [[Ota system/Legends|Ota systems]] before that route's [[Coachelle system/Legends|Coachelle]]-Ota segment was severed by a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. A minor [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] world, Coachelle Prime was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], [[lagomorph]]ic [[Lepi/Legends|Lepi]] [[Species/Legends|species]], members of which lived in vast underground warrens. The Lepi [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jaxxon/Legends|Jaxxon]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on Coachelle Prime and eventually stole away from his homeworld aboard a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]].

==Description==
Coachelle Prime,<ref name="Gamer4" /> also known simply as Coachelle,<ref name="TEA" /> was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Gamer4" /> located in the [[Coachelle system/Legends|Coachelle system]], a part of the [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar sector]] in the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]]. It constituted a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] connected Coachelle Prime to the [[Terr'skiar system/Legends|Terr'skiar system]] and originally also linked it to the [[Ota system/Legends|Ota system]] of the neighboring [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]]; however, the destruction of the [[Kyyr system]] by a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]<ref name="TEA" /> in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> and the resultant formation of the [[Thornhedge Pulsar]] and the [[Thornhedge Nebula/Legends|Thornhedge Nebula]] severed the Coachelle-Ota segment of the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route. Afterward, Coachelle Prime became shrouded in streamers of [[Gas/Legends|gas]] and dust from the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]].<ref name="TEA" /> The planet shared its name with [[Coachelle Automata/Legends|Coachelle Automata]], a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing company that designed the [[LEP servant droid/Legends|LEP servant droid]].<ref name="Scavenger">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:Jaxxon-gamer.jpg|thumb|right|215px|Jaxxon was born on Coachelle Prime.]]
The [[Lepi/Legends|Lepi]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to Coachelle Prime,<ref name="Gamer4" /> were known off-world<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=starfighter|type=other|Emote: [[Lepi Hop]] from the [[Cartel Market]]}}</ref> by [[3637 BBY]].<ref name="LepiHopDate">{{TOR_updates|2.6}}</ref> In response to overpopulation on Coachelle Prime, the Lepi invented the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and went on to [[Colonist/Legends|colonize]] all the other worlds in their [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="Gamer4" />

At one point, the Lepi future [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jaxxon/Legends|Jaxxon]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on Coachelle Prime and was raised in a quiet community. Although he had a rambunctious nature, [[Jaxxon's mother]] hoped he would eventually settle down and<ref name="Gamer4" /> [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] a [[Gender/Legends|girl]] from a nice burrow.<ref name="SW10">[[Star Wars (1977) 10|''Star Wars'' (1977) 10]]</ref> Jaxxon, however, longed to travel off-world, and, when he was twelve [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, he stole away from his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] aboard a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], traveling to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Gamer4" /> at some point by [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="Invitation Only Date">{{TCWdates|122}} Therefore the events of ''[[The Clone Wars: Invitation Only]]'', which lead into those of "Hostage Crisis" and feature a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] posting poster for [[Jaxxon/Legends|Jaxxon]] on [[Keyorin]], must be set in that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as well.</ref>

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Lepi/Legends}}
Coachelle Prime was the homeworld of the Lepi, a species of sentient,<ref name="Gamer4" /> [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]-shaped,<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]]<ref name="CSWE Lepi">{{CSWECite|II|250|Lepi}}</ref> [[lagomorph]]s who spoke the [[Lepese]] [[Language/Legends|language]]. A [[Realspace/Legends|spacefaring]] species, the Lepi had many [[Starship/Legends|starships]] left poorly guarded in the Coachelle system, including on Coachelle Prime.<ref name="Gamer4" /> Their homeworld eventually came to serve as minor [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] world.<ref name="TEA" />

==Locations==
The Lepi inhabited extensive warrens that they had built underneath their homeworld's surface. Coachelle Prime featured several juvenile remand centers where the Lepi Jaxxon spent many of his formative years.<ref name="Gamer4" />

==Behind the scenes==
Coachelle Prime was introduced in the article "[[The Starhoppers of Aduba-3]]," which was authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] with [[Cory J. Herndon]] and [[Michael Mikaelian]] for use with [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' and published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 4|fourth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Gamer4" /> in [[June 19]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20010503.html|text=The Wild Side of ''Star Wars Gamer''}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' introduced a shortened name for the planet and placed it in grid square P-10.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:BugsBunny-BullyForBugs.png|thumb|right|300px|The name of Coachelle Prime was chosen as a reference to a line in the cartoon short "Bully for Bugs" by the character Bugs Bunny (pictured).]]
In [[2006]], Hidalgo confirmed that, given the character Jaxxon had originally been created as an homage to the [[Wikipedia:Looney Tunes|''Looney Tunes'']] cartoon short character [[Wikipedia:Bugs Bunny|Bugs Bunny]], the name of Coachelle Prime had also been chosen in reference to that franchise. The ''Star Wars Gamer'' article contains the phrase "[&hellip;] having colonized all five worlds of the Coachelle system and the asteroid belt therein [&hellip;]," which references Bugs Bunny's line from the [[1950s|1953]] short "[[Wikipedia:Bully for Bugs|Bully for Bugs]]:"<ref name="Gamer Endnotes">{{Blog|pablog|60|Tales of the Big Green Bunny: Behind the Scenes of Gamer #4 &mdash; The Coachella Valley, and the Giant Carrot Festival}}</ref> "Pardon me, sir, but could you direct me to the shortest route to the [[Wikipedia:Coachella Valley|Coachella Valley]] and the Big Carrot Festival&hellip; therein?"<ref name="BullyForBugs">"[[Wikipedia:Bully for Bugs|Bully for Bugs]]"</ref>
